title: Data of normalized tensor and pullback comparisons
statement: Fix a finite field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, and a finite extension E of Q_l. For a finite-type scheme X over the algebraic closure in D, and normalized realization a [def-real-lisse-realization-data], define realizationOrdinaryTensor to be the published ordinary derived tensor over the rational coefficient sheaf. Define RealizationTensorCalculation to consist of a specified TensorModel [def-real-lisse-tensor-normalization] on every pair of good integral representatives, flat-term K-flat rational representatives and the scalar-extension counit identifications. Its arrow is scalar extension of inverse completion, followed by the scalar counit, the balanced scalar tensor map, the published K-flat representative comparison, and the two endpoint identifications. Define RealizationTensorComparison to consist of a coherent lisse tensor and its normalization, a natural integral derived comparison calculated by those arrows on every good model, a raw rational natural comparison with its integral conjugation equation, the degree-zero specialization, and multiplication unit with its specified derived counit equation. For any scheme morphism f:X to Y define RealizationPullComparison to consist of Along and PullNormalized [def-real-lisse-pullback-normalization], a natural comparison on raw rational objects and equality on integral objects with the normalized inverse-completion scalar-square comparison. These are exactly the original five data declarations moved to a shared module, with no changed field, parameter or construction.
